class.name: HEGoBaseNode
class.brief_description: Virtual base class for all HEGo node wrappers.
class.description:
Stores the underlying Houdini node id and provides shared lifecycle behavior for derived HEGo node classes.
A node id of [code]-1[/code] means no valid Houdini node is currently associated with this instance.
Most derived methods assume [method instantiate] has already produced a valid id.

method.name: delete_node
method.description:
Submits a task that deletes this node from the Houdini session and resets the stored id to [code]-1[/code].
HEGo creates every node with no parent, so Houdini wraps it in an object node of its own under [code]/obj[/code]; that object is what gets deleted, together with the node's cook caches and HEGo's cached copy of its output geometry. Nodes a session no longer holds are only forgotten. Call it once the node's output has been read, for example through [method HEGoAssetAgent.release], to keep a long editor session from accumulating Houdini memory. A later [method instantiate] creates the node again.
Returns an [HEGoTask] whose result is the id of the deleted object node, or [code]null[/code] when there was nothing to delete. It fails when the node was re-instantiated or reset before the task ran, or when Houdini refuses the deletion.

method.name: get_id
method.description: Returns the Houdini node id, or [code]-1[/code] when not instantiated.

method.name: instantiate
method.description:
Submits a task to create the underlying Houdini node.
This base implementation does nothing. Concrete subclasses override it and usually register themselves with the session manager after successful creation.
Returns an [HEGoTask] that completes when the node has been created.

method.name: reset_node_id
method.description: Resets the stored node id to [code]-1[/code].
